body.p: Dyooa. Nibiyu said: "I have made a sokuy from a black calf skin, and a fur coat from a calf skin." Dyooa put them on and went into the forest. Dyooa walked for some time, met a dry stump. Dyooa put the sokuy on it, put his fur coat on it. Dyooa hit the mouldering stump with his fist and said: "Let's run together." The mouldering stump said: "Wait, my roots are strong, Iâll tear off the roots.â. The mouldering stump started to move, then it ran quickly, it took away Dyooa's sokuy and fur coat forever. Dyooa said: "Now I'll come home, Nibiyu will scold me." Dyooa said: âNow let it be so, Iâll get clothes for myself anyway, once rich people come.â. Dyooa reached Nibiyu's tent. Nibiyu said: "Where are the clothes?" Dyooa said: âYou said that there were relatives without clothes, I dressed the relatives.â.[ShA:] N'i form looks strange here. Dyooa said to Nibiyu: âWait, rich people will come, Iâll scare them anyway, Iâll get clothes for myself.â. Of course, Dyooa slept, he got up in the morning. At that time, it was winter. Dyooa checked the snares as always, he went to the snares. At some point, while walking, Dyooa arrived to some tent place. Dyooa found a bone of a bull's shoulder blade in the tent place. Dyooa said: "What will I do with this bone?" Dyooa took the bone on his shoulder, he brought it to the tent. Dyooa began to work with this bone. He froze the bone with snow. Then he beat his own nose with a log, with his fists, he took blood out of his nose. Dyooa froze the shoulder blade bone hard, made it look like reindeer meat with his blood. Dyooa put the bone outside on a lean-to (?). After they slept, the rich people arrived in the morning. As for sokuys and fur coats made out of calf skin, they took them off outside, one threw it on the lean-to, one threw it on the sledge. Dyooa said to Nibiyu: "We should feed the guests." "Outside, I have meat, a bull's meat." Dyooa ran outside and brought a large scapula, barely brought it, it was the meat of a big reindeer. He said to Nibiyu: "Hang up the copper cauldron." Dyooa said: âPut the meat into the cauldron, let the meat get cooked. Iâll go outside quickly, while the guests are waiting for the cauldron.â. After a while, he entered the tent. He said: "Nibiyu, Nibiyu, the cauldron is ready, it has started to boil." After some time, Nibiyu took out the bone of the shoulder blade from the cauldron and said: âThere is not even meat on this bone.â. Dyooa got angry: "The guests, of course, ate the meat while I was walking on the street." Dyooa grabbed a long wooden dish, jumped around the corners around the fire, he jumped like a crazy man. People, got scared, ran out outside, some of them ran, some took off their reins, sat on the sledges, and went away, they even forgot to take their clothes. Their clothes remained at Dyooa's lean-to and at Dyooa's sledges. Dyooa said: "Nibiyu, Nibiyu, you said, you have no clothes, there are a lot of clothes outside." "I stayed with the clothes." Even now there are people similar to Dyooa.[ShA:] 3rd person is unexpected here.
